description: This file defines the `LoanNotFoundException` class, which extends an abstract exception to handle cases where a loan resource is not found in the system. It provides multiple constructors for different ways of identifying a loan, such as by ID, account ID, or external ID.

classes.name: LoanNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that a loan resource was not found. Extends `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` to provide specific messaging for missing loans.

methods.name: LoanNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Long ID, invoking the superclass constructor with an error code and message indicating the loan ID does not exist.

methods.name: LoanNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Long ID and an Exception e, passing all to the superclass for detailed exception chaining.

methods.name: LoanNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting an accountId String, for looking up by account identifier.

methods.name: LoanNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting an ExternalId object, indicating the absence of a loan with that external identifier.

methods.name: LoanNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting an ExternalId and Exception for chained exception details.
